source.note: Curated from the public TWiN profile and revision-specific project evidence. Public interfaces preserve separate maturity and source-boundary labels.

published.name: ARCANE OS
published.description: An AI-native development environment for governed capabilities, policy gates, app-scoped data, and accountable human–AI collaboration.

published.name: Arcane OS SDK
published.description: A development SDK and CLI for building, testing, packaging, and managing Arcane applications inside or outside ARCANE OS.

published.name: Arcane Exchange
published.description: A public discovery marketplace for Arcane applications, AI tools, public catalogs, and private portals—not an installer.

published.name: Astrolabe
published.description: An interactive map that makes the TWiN ecosystem understandable across foundations, platforms, products, programs, audiences, funding, and native hosts.

published.name: DBOPFS
published.description: A released browser-native local data layer built on OPFS: tables become directories, records become files, and data stays local unless exported.

published.name: DBOPFS Studio
published.description: A development Chromium workspace for exploring, editing, previewing, printing, and managing DBOPFS application data stored in OPFS.

published.name: SpellWire
published.description: A public guide to a private, auditable protocol for human-and-AI teams to exchange context, evidence, requests, and decisions.

published.name: Toshokann
published.description: A documentation-first foundation for organizing and retrieving institutional knowledge as a library, archive, repository, or information-sharing home.

published.name: TWiN Compass
published.description: A versioned source kit for purpose-built local models that keeps moral reasoning and behavioral-health awareness active together.

published.name: KEMPO
published.description: A repeatable, human-scored 100-scenario evaluation of AI judgment across behavioral safety, ethics, cyber, crisis, and public safety.

published.name: Sentinel
published.description: An in-development, provenance-first workspace for turning complex records into source-cited, human-reviewed leads and reports.

published.name: Scamurai
published.description: A pre-release scam and abuse defense foundation built around evidence, explanation, consent, and human agency.

published.name: Redress
published.description: A source-grounded legal-practice workbench currently inside ARCANE OS; no standalone application release is claimed.

publishingNext.name: PreCrisis
publishingNext.description: TWiN's core early-signal behavioral-health technology is in development; its first dedicated public project site is forthcoming.

publishingNext.name: SDE
publishingNext.description: The Synthetic Decision Environment is being developed for emergency interoperability and early-warning work; its first public TWiN project site is forthcoming.

publishingNext.name: Warrior Spirit Companion
publishingNext.description: A Veteran-community PreCrisis companion is in development; its first public TWiN project site is forthcoming.
